claims.claim: NativeExecutionPolicy now defaults to a 180-minute response budget and a finite 185-minute process watchdog. Its resolver accepts only mutation authorization.
Existing PRIMARY, REMEDIATION and REPAIR factories pass the shared policy to all three adapters, preserving their authority mappings and model selection.
Timeout handlers preserve original captured diagnostics and exception provenance, leave absent native exit status unknown, and remain terminal under Dispatcher's single-invocation boundary.
Successful native returns proceed directly to normalization without waiting, retry, executor substitution or follow-on dispatch.

Deterministic synthetic regressions cover exact policy values, all provider/operation combinations, mutation settings, early completion, timeout diagnostics, missing executables, nonzero and unknown exits, and malformed output.
